contexts.text: The hereditary evil from the father... can never be eradicated.
(The Israelites) had an Hereditary which could not be eradicated by regeneration. Signified.
The hereditary evil from the father... cannot be easily eradicated; but that from the mother can.
That which is inrooted in both (the intellectual and the voluntary) lives of man... cannot be rooted out; for the very soul of man which lives after death has been formed by these things...
The truths which have once become matters of faith remain, nor can they be eradicated, and the falsities which afterwards become matters of faith conjoin themselves with them.
Nothing which a man has appropriated to himself can be eradicated...
This can be done only gradually, by eradicating evil from its seed...
That in the other life impressions about others are eradicated with great difficulty.
28. Falsities are to be eradicated before truths are implanted.
